## Services

### AI Development
Custom model training, fine-tuning, and prompt engineering — AI built for your domain, not generic chatbots. (Fine-Tuning, RAG Pipelines, Multi-Agent Systems, Domain Training)

### AI Deployment (core offering)
Production-grade deployment on your infrastructure — bare metal, cloud, or hybrid. Containerized, orchestrated, and monitored from day one. (Kubernetes-Native, GPU Optimization, Auto-Scaling, Zero-Downtime Rollouts)

### AI Operations
24/7 monitoring, incident response, and continuous optimization. (Real-Time Monitoring, Incident Response, Cost Optimization, Drift Detection)

### Sovereign Infrastructure
Data never leaves your perimeter. On-premises or private cloud with full encryption, audit logging, and compliance built in. (On-Prem & Private Cloud, E2E Encryption, Audit Trails, GDPR & SOC 2)

### AI Integration
Connect AI to existing systems — ERP, CRM, databases, APIs — without disrupting workflows. (API-First, ERP/CRM Connectors, Legacy Bridging, Event Pipelines)

### AI Strategy & Audit
Audit of operations, identification of highest-impact AI opportunities, and a roadmap from pilot to production. (Readiness Assessment, ROI Modeling, Technology Selection, Roadmap)

## The Sovereign AI Stack
- Application Layer: Multi-Agent Orchestrator, RAG Engine, API Gateway, Web UI
- Inference Layer: vLLM / TGI, Model Router, Batch Scheduler, Cache Layer
- Orchestration Layer: Kubernetes, Helm Charts, GPU Scheduler, Istio
- Infrastructure Layer: NVIDIA A100/H100, Private Cloud, Bare Metal, Terraform

## Process
1. Discovery & Audit — analyze data, infrastructure, and objectives; build the business case
2. Architecture & Design — model selection, infrastructure sizing, security model, integration points
3. Build & Train — develop, fine-tune, and test with your team until the quality bar is met
4. Deploy & Harden — production deployment with monitoring, security hardening, and compliance checks
5. Operate & Optimize — 24/7 monitoring, incident response, and continuous improvement

## Pricing (published rates)
- Sovereign AI Hosting: $30–100/month by GPU allocation (hosted Ollama / Open WebUI tenancy)
- Private AI Box: $2,000–5,000 setup + $50–150/month care plan (local LLM appliance for confidentiality-sensitive teams)
- AI Operations Retainer: from $500/month (fully managed production AI stack)
- Project engagements scoped individually; AI Strategy & Audit starts at $2,500
- Every plan includes quarterly vulnerability scans; 5% discount for payment in Bitcoin (via BTCPay)
